clue.text: Austin welcomes sextet, regularly presenting musical piece

indicators.note: to welcome is to take someone in, so the car name holds the picked letters

parts.note: the Austin Allegro was a 1970s British family car

indicators.note: taking every other letter of the word sextet, the even ones

explanation.surface: A man called Austin hosts a group of six who perform a piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: Austin is not a person but the car maker: the Austin Allegro was a British car. Its name takes in ETT, the even letters of sextet.
explanation.definitionFit: An allegretto is a moderately quick movement or composition, hence a piece of music.
